context: Sho-young brings home his first school report card; nervous and proud.
purpose: Child showing academic milestone to elder grandfather.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、通知表、見て!
lines.style: Quick bright opening. Eager, bouncing slightly in the voice. That nervous-proud energy of a child who worked hard and wants approval. Slight breathless finish on the reveal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Warm, unhurried Kansai cadence. A gentle settling-in—he's already pleased just by the child's excitement. Soft, inviting tone that says *come here, show me*.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I really tried—I did my best.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity under the surface. Small boy voice, not performing—just stating a fact he wants believed. Soft on the second clause, almost checking himself for bragging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: すごいやんか、誇りに思うわ。
lines.style: Genuine warmth, no performance. Slow, measured delivery. The weight of real approval from someone he trusts. Kansai lilt on the closing—fondness settling in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, unguarded delight. Quick tempo, almost bouncing. That pure child-joy of being seen and praised by someone who matters. Warm, open, genuine.
